name: Qoder
desc: Task-centered desktop app that delegates work to agents
desc_zh: 以任务为中心、把活派给智能体的桌面应用
solves: IDE, terminal agent and scripts each hold part of the work; one workspace now runs, watches and reviews every task.
solves_zh: 代码、报告和原型分散在不同工具里，现在一个工作区就能派发、跟踪并验收任务。
best_for: You need a report, prototype or code change done end to end and would rather review than build.
best_for_zh: 手里有一件要从头做到尾的活，比如出报告或做原型，你想只做验收。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://changelog.qoder.com/llms.txt, https://changelog.qoder.com/app.md, ht）。 This is the all-new task-based desktop app, NOT the IDE. The ledger entry Qoder@2025-08-22 is the IDE launch; Qoder IDE keeps its own changelog (changelog.qoder.com/ide, version line now 1.41.x) while this app has its own line (0.1.0 on 2026-08-27, 0.5.18 on 2026-11-24). The app absorbs QoderWork (public beta 2026-02-12, service ends 2027-09-05, see qoderwork.json). A CN edition exists at qoder.cn. Other second source read: https://finance.sina.com.cn/tech/digi/2026-08-27/doc-inipttax5846771.shtml (新浪科技, same headline). 入库核对（2026-11-25）：地区与账本里的 Qoder（IDE）保持一致。 两者同名，入库时把 IDE 那条按官方文档改名为 Qoder IDE。 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.qoder.com/qoder-desktop
